question: 6 men and 8 women could finish a work in 14 days. 8 men and 12 women could finish the same work in 10 days. How much time would be taken to finish the same work if one man worked alone?
solution:
**Given:**

6 men and 8 women could finish a work in 14 days.

8 men and 12 women could finish the same work in 10 days.

We need to find how much time one man would take to finish the same work alone.
